_comment: Ground-plane calibration for one camera: 4 image points (normalised u,v; v=0 top) and where they lie on the section (x = chainage m, y = lateral m, + north). On site these come from surveyed markers during installation; these values are a DEMO calibration for a camera on tower T12 at Madukkarai crossing (H3), mounted south of the track and looking north.
